name: Word of Moderate Healing, Mass
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level bard 6, cleric/oracle 6, druid 7, inquisitor 6, shaman 6, witch 6

This spell functions like mass word of light healing except that it heals 2d4 + 1 per two caster levels to all creatures (maximum +15).
